observations: The page number «50» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature and no footnotes. L01: «gelassenen» completes «fallen-» at the end of p. 49 (JP2 0081, L39).

L02-L03: the sentence of Chasles quoted again, «L’équation en question est précisément la moitié de l’équation du centre», with «précisément», where p. 49 (JP2 0081, L35) prints «précisement»; see the critical note there.

L17-L20 and L28-L31: the two comparisons, each set as a small table in four columns: «Batt.» and «Kh.» spaced at the left; «Aequat. (anomal. et) centri» and «Aequat. anomaliae» over the second and third of al-Battānī's figures, «Sublim. examin.» (L19; «Sublim. exam.» in L30), «Examin. centri» and «Examin. argumenti (anomaliae)» over al-Khwārizmī's three; each figure centred under its heading. Each printed row is one line here, the cells separated by our «|»; the empty cells give the columns room and are not printed.

L21-L25 and L32-L35. Checked: half of 5° 10′ is 2° 35′; 244° 55′ − 2° 35′ = 242° 20′, the Sublimatio examinata of the table; 2° 35′ + 6° 2′ = 8° 37′, 36′ more than 8° 1′. Half of 9° 25′ is 4° 42½′, written 4° 42′; 172° 32′ − 4° 42′ = 167° 50′; 4° 44′ − 4° 42′ = 2′. The apogees of Saturn and Jupiter, 244° 55′ and 172° 32′, are those of the text, p. 14 (JP2 0046), and of p. 46 (JP2 0078, L26). The figures of Tables 27, 29 and 35 are to be compared with the tables.

L34: «=167° 50′»: the equals sign is set close to the figures (4 px), its lower bar broken into two pieces, and the 1 is a bold sort, heavier and wider than the 6 and the 7; transcribed as printed. The list of misprints, p. [237] (JP2 0271, L12), reads «167°» for «67°» in this line: in this copy the 1 stands already, in the heavier sort. L12: «kleiner wie», as printed. L35: «(vergl. Nachträge)», the additions at the end of the book, pp. [233]-235 (JP2 0265-0267), which take back the conclusion drawn on this page (p. [233], JP2 0265, L19-L23).

Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Ptol.», «Chasles», «Kh.», «Batt.»; italics: «Aequans», the quotation of L02-L03, «Hälfte der Gleichung der Anomalie», «Examinatio argumenti», «Apogeums» (L06), «Sublimatio examinata», «Gleichung» and «Centrums» (L09), «Gleichung der Anomalie» (L21, L32), «Praezession».
The colons and semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (8-14 px measured).
